ai-generator 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI Generator skill for text-to-video creation.
- Users can generate 30-second videos from text prompts or script ideas in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, WebM, and AVI files up to 500MB.
- Includes workflows for credits checking, file uploads, video exports, and session state monitoring.
- Automatic cloud rendering pipeline with guide for error handling and user feedback.
- Designed for content creators and marketers seeking fast, automated video generation without manual editing.
